tasks.label: Install Backend Dependencies
tasks.command: cd backend && venv\Scripts\activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && echo Backend dependencies installed for Chotopata Pathagar
tasks.detail: Install Python packages for Chotopata Pathagar backend

tasks.label: Install Frontend Dependencies
tasks.command: cd frontend && npm install && echo Frontend dependencies installed for Chotopata Pathagar
tasks.detail: Install Node.js packages for Chotopata Pathagar frontend

tasks.label: Install All Dependencies
tasks.detail: Install all dependencies for complete Chotopata Pathagar system

tasks.label: Check Database Connection
tasks.command: cd backend && venv\Scripts\activate && python -c "import asyncio; from src.database_async import test_connection; asyncio.run(test_connection())" && echo Chotopata Pathagar database connection successful
tasks.detail: Verify PostgreSQL database connection for library system

tasks.label: Run Database Migration
tasks.command: cd backend && venv\Scripts\activate && alembic upgrade head && echo Database migration completed for Chotopata Pathagar

tasks.label: Clean Build Artifacts
tasks.command: cd backend && rmdir /s /q __pycache__ 2>nul & rmdir /s /q src\__pycache__ 2>nul & rmdir /s /q src\models\__pycache__ 2>nul & cd ..\frontend && rmdir /s /q .next 2>nul & echo Cleaned build artifacts for Chotopata Pathagar
tasks.detail: Clean Python cache and Next.js build files
